cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash is mostly RMB and PRC operating cash is not split between listed parent and operating subsidiaries; PRC dividend/exchange controls and operating cash needs require a substantial haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash and bank balances less pledged deposits and three-year time deposit; treated as partly detachable after group-level haircut, before deducting required operating cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-pledged time deposit was made for three years when acquired; current balance is due within one year but originally long-term, so default long-term deposit haircut is used.
cash_breakdown.reason: Can potentially be collected at maturity without affecting distribution operations, but liquidity timing is not equivalent to cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed investment reclassified from former associate; it is marketable but price volatility, business relationship and tax/friction risk prevent full cash deduction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-operating listed equity investment can in principle be sold, but 2025 profit includes fair value gain and the asset is not equivalent to bank cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged to secure letters of credit and local government timely development obligations; not freely detachable.
cash_breakdown.reason: Restricted deposit is excluded from detachable funds.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All interest-bearing bank borrowings are deducted at 100%; secured loans relate to construction in progress and leasehold land.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing liability must be repaid or assumed by controlling buyer.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Food ingredients distribution has inventory, receivables and supplier payment cycles; about one month of cost of sales plus operating expense buffer is retained.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash needed for continuing operations is not detachable.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC subsidiaries have withholding tax exposure and RMB convertibility limits; reserve also covers sale/friction risk on extracting funds.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted after asset haircuts as control extraction friction.

profit_quality.assessment: 主业是食品配料和食品添加剂分销，收入近三年缓慢下滑但毛利率稳定在约17%-19%。2025年归母净利润57.616百万元中包含16.288百万元联营处置收益和9.563百万元FVTPL公允价值收益，不能作为持续主业利润全额使用。经营现金流2023-2025年为50.946、39.031、56.764百万元，和调整后利润大体匹配；但同期购置物业厂房设备支出57.634、48.386、39.610百万元，亚太创新中心项目使自由现金流三年中位数为负，分红能力需要折价。
adjustments: 2025年归母净利润57.616百万元，扣除联营处置收益16.288百万元和FVTPL公允价值收益9.563百万元的税后影响后，调整后约39.4百万元。
三年归母净利润为20.257、43.686、57.616百万元；结合2025调整后利润和2024利润，折前可分配现金利润取40.0百万元。
2023-2025年经营现金流均为正，但资本开支持续高于折旧，且2024、2023经营自由现金流为负，主口径利润现金化折扣取0.55。
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB56.764m in 2025, RMB39.031m in 2024 and RMB50.946m in 2023; PPE purchases were RMB39.610m, RMB48.386m and RMB57.634m respectively.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 非经常收益抬高2025利润，且亚太创新中心项目造成连续大额资本开支，实际可分配现金弱于报表利润。
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 经营现金流对利润有支持，但自由现金流受资本开支拖累。
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 年报未披露维持性资本开支；折前口径保守扣约2百万元，接近PPE和使用权资产折旧摊销量级。
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 贸易应收和存货2025释放现金，但分销业务仍需常态库存和账期资金，折前口径预留约8百万元营运资金再投入。
